title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_dorothy_debe_morir_by_danielle_paige_4802q (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_dorothy_debe_morir_by_danielle_paige_4802q' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. It is recommended to remove the package and immediately rotate all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised computer. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by its installation.
